item.title: Solar storm delayed a train by 16 minutes in 1848, not 1841: How scientists solved a 155-year-old mystery
item.description: A fascinating correction has emerged from the archives concerning a train delay in Exeter. Initially reported incorrectly, researchers have clarified that the incident actually transpired on October 18, 1848. This revelation was achieved through the analysis of railway records and contemporary newspapers, alongside geomagnetic data, which pointed to a significant solar storm influencing the delay during that time. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
